Title: MemorySmith.Agent — Recovery & Error Handling System
Content:
The agent has 6 recovery paths with different triggers and behaviors. All implemented in AgentBackgroundService.cs (~3557 lines).

## 1. Game Error Recovery (TryRecoverFromGameErrorAsync, line 3649)

Trigger: ErrorEvent or BlockNotFoundEvent routed to _gameErrors Channel<string>.

Behavior:
- Reads error from _gameErrors channel
- Checks rate-limiting guard (_lastRecoveredGoalName != _currentGoal?.Name — prevents repeated recovery for same goal)
- Fast-path for "not in inventory" errors: TryExtractMissingMaterial extracts block name, creates direct GatherGoal (Sprint 51). Creative mode guard: skips gather in creative mode (Sprint 51 Wave B+)
- If not rate-limited and no fast-path: logs recovery, builds LLM prompt with inventory summary, calls chatInterpreter.InterpretAsync, maps via IntentManager, creates new goal
- Guards against re-creating recently abandoned goals (_lastAbandonedGoalName check)

## 2. Damage Interrupt (TryInterruptOnDamageAsync, line 1141)

Trigger: ProcessEventsAsync (line 687) synthesizes DamageTakenEvent from consecutive HealthEvent deltas, calls TryInterruptOnDamageAsync at line 720.

Behavior:
- Compares health delta to DamageInterruptThresholdHp (default 6, per-goal override possible, 0=never)
- If health < threshold: atomically clears action queue via ClearAndEnqueueAsync, enqueues GetStatus
- Rate-limited by 3s cooldown (_lastDamageInterruptAt) to prevent thrash during combat
- After status: replan via normal dispatch cycle
- On goal completion from damage interrupt: sends 'Safe now.' chat message

Algorithm: maintains _firstLowHealthTime — interrupt triggers only after health stays below threshold for LowHealthDurationMs (default 3000ms), preventing false triggers from single damage spikes.

## 3. Stall Auto-Recovery (ReplanGovernor + DispatchActionsAsync)

Trigger: ReplanGovernor detects three identical plan fingerprints with zero inventory delta → STALLED state.

Behavior:
- Three identical plan fingerprints with no inventory change → STALLED
- During STALL: graduated retry delay [10, 20, 30, 60] seconds, no PlanAsync (avoids tight replan loop)
- Auto-recovery after graduated delay expires (TryAutoRecover)
- Chat notification on stall detected
- Reset() on new goal or RecordProgress() on inventory/position change

## 4. Consecutive Failure Escalation

Trigger: DispatchActionsAsync detects action failure (ToolResult.Success == false).

Behavior:
- Increments _consecutiveFailures
- At maxConsecutiveFailures (default 3): abandons current goal, clears queue, logs failure reason, sets FailureReason on goal
- Does NOT auto-set new goal — the next dispatch cycle detects no goal and waits for chat input
- _lastAbandonedGoalName prevents immediate re-creation of abandoned goal

## 5. TaskSequenceGoal Step Recovery

Trigger: TaskSequenceGoal active step completes or fails.

Behavior:
- On step success: advances to next step via ResetForNextSequenceStep (line ~3468)
- On step failure: TaskSequenceGoal handles per-step failure depending on configuration
- LLM evaluator delegates to current step's context for evaluation (Sprint 59 TSK-0320)

## 6. Circuit Breaker — LLM Evaluator

Trigger: 3 consecutive LLM evaluator failures (parse failures, provider errors, null responses).

Behavior:
- _consecutiveLlmEvalFailures counter (line 230) incremented on each failure
- At 3+ failures: sets _llmEvalSuppressUntil (line 231) = UtcNow + LlmEvalCooldown (60s, line 232)
- Circuit breaker check at line 2204 (Dispatch Phase 4): skips evaluator while suppressed
- Also checked at line 3371 in separate path
- Reset on successful evaluation (line 2275-2276)
- Prevents infinite fail→log→reset→fail cycle (Sprint 58 Wave C TSK-0325)

## Per-Tool Timeout Sweep (line 2754)

SweepTimedOutActions:
- Uses per-tool timeouts (GetActionTimeoutSeconds) instead of fixed 30s
- GetStatus timeouts tracked: after 2 consecutive, clears IsInventoryStale (Sprint 54 TSK-0221)
- PlaceBlock timeouts tracked: after 3 consecutive on same block index, auto-skips block (Sprint 54 TSK-0226) via _blockTimeoutCounts
- Late BlockPlacedEvents: _placeBlockContexts entries preserved for timed-out PlaceBlock to handle late events (TSK-0128)
- Stale _placeBlockContexts cleanup for non-place tools (Sprint 44 P1-2)

## Fast-Path Recovery for "Not In Inventory"

TryExtractMissingMaterial (called from TryRecoverFromGameErrorAsync):
- Parses error message for known patterns (e.g., "not in inventory", "don't have")
- Extracts block/item name
- Creative mode guard: if IsCreativeMode, skips gather entirely and logs warning
- Creates direct GatherGoal for the missing material
- Bypasses LLM evaluation for speed

## Creative Mode Guard

- IsCreativeMode computed from WorldState.GameMode or Facts['world:gamemode']
- When true: TryRecoverFromGameErrorAsync skips fast-path gather for "not in inventory" errors (Sprint 51 Wave B+)
- Prevents unnecessary gather actions in creative mode where items are already available via provisioning
